issues.description: The solution's Person entity declares the birthday attribute as a String while its getter/setter and the rest of the code (service logic and tests) expect a java.time.LocalDate. Specifically, solution_repository/src/main/java/de/tum/in/ase/eist/model/Person.java defines 'private String birthday;' but later declares 'public LocalDate getBirthday()' and 'public void setBirthday(LocalDate birthday)'. This type mismatch will cause compilation errors and contradicts the template and tests that treat birthday as LocalDate, preventing students from running or comparing against the provided solution and confusing them about the correct type to use.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the birthday field in the solution's Person entity use java.time.LocalDate to match the getters/setters, service logic, and tests. Concretely, in solution_repository/src/main/java/de/tum/in/ase/eist/model/Person.java replace 'private String birthday;' with 'private java.time.LocalDate birthday;' (and ensure 'import java.time.LocalDate;' is present). This aligns the solution with the template and tests and removes the compile-time/type inconsistency.
